newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia communists demand government changes.
newsitem.headline: Russia communists demand government changes.

text.p: Russian communist leader Gennady Zyuganov, accusing the government of breaking Russia up and selling it off cheap, urged parliament on Wednesday to ask President Boris Yeltsin to reshuffle the cabinet.

"The government is made up of people personally responsible for policies hostile to the population -- impoverishment and rip-off privatisation. We must suggest that the president reviews the cabinet line-up," Zyuganov told the lower house of parliament, the State Duma.
"(Yeltsin) must form a government of true national interests."

Zyuganov was speaking after Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin presented a report on Russia's economy in the first quarter in which he admitted that budget revenues had been below target and asked deputies to approve spending cuts.
"We must recognise the work of the cabinet as unsatisfactory, noting that the under-achievement of the budget is a result of Yeltsin's vicious policy," said Zyuganov.
"The president and his team bear the main responsibility for policies which have at their heart the disintegration of Russia and selling it off cheap," he added.
